top.zoneHint: The time zone and the 12 / 24 h default are in

search.discordLookupHint: Only for you: uses the hub's member search (the hub has to be unlocked).

backup.syncLocal: Saved in this browser. Log in to have it on every device.
backup.syncOn: Saved on your account, on every device where you're logged in.
backup.syncWhat: Synced: look, layout, pages, widgets and their settings, search engines. Integrations live on your account itself. Cached answers (feeds, weather …) stay in each browser.
backup.tooBig: Your dash is bigger than {{limit}} and doesn't sync any more (long notes, HTML or many links). It's still saved in this browser.
backup.ownerUnlimited: As the site owner, your dash has no size limit.
backup.title: Backup
backup.help: Download everything as a file, or load one. Integrations aren't in it (their keys never leave the server).
backup.importFailed: That file could not be imported.
backup.newTabHelp: Set this address as your browser's home page. For new tabs, browsers need a small extension (search for “custom new tab URL”).
backup.cacheCleared: Cached data cleared; widgets load fresh.
backup.css: Custom CSS for the whole site is in

css.title: Custom CSS
css.help: This CSS is applied to every page of the site. Add ?nocss to any URL to temporarily disable it.
css.replace: Replace the site's CSS entirely (only use your CSS)
css.replaceWarning: All built-in styles are disabled. If the page becomes unusable, open /dash?nocss to fix it.

pages.label: Dash pages
pages.title: Pages
pages.help: Pages are tabs of the board, each with its own widgets (e.g. Home, Work, Media). Alt + 1–9 switches between them.
pages.name: Name

startChoices.last: The last page you had open

integrations.login: Log in to connect your services. Integrations are saved on your account.
integrations.safety: Passwords, tokens and keys are sealed on the server and never sent back to any browser; your services are asked by the server, never from this page.
integrations.privateOn: As the site owner you can also use addresses on your own network.
integrations.privateOff: Only public addresses work (not localhost or your home network).
integrations.pick: What do you want to connect?
integrations.name: Name
integrations.savedSecret: Saved · leave empty to keep it
integrations.broken: Its password or key was saved on another server: edit it and type it in again.

kinds.navidrome: Your music server: what's playing, new and random albums, library size.
kinds.jellyfin: Your media server: who's watching or listening, latest additions, library counts.
kinds.github: Private repositories and 5000 requests an hour instead of 60, for releases and repositories.
kinds.gitlab: Private projects on gitlab.com or your own GitLab.
kinds.gitea: Gitea, Forgejo or Codeberg: your own instance, private repositories with a token.
kinds.pihole: Queries, blocked queries and the block list of your Pi-hole.
kinds.adguard: Queries, blocked queries and speed of AdGuard Home.
kinds.homeassistant: States of your devices and sensors; lights and switches can be switched.
kinds.uptimekuma: The monitors of one of your status pages.
kinds.sonarr: Upcoming episodes and the download queue.
kinds.radarr: Upcoming movies and the download queue.
kinds.glances: CPU, memory, disks and load of a server running Glances.
kinds.custom: Any JSON API, with a secret header (API key) kept on the server.

help.intro: Integrations connect the dash to your services, like in Homarr. Add one here, then pick it in a widget's settings; one integration can feed several widgets.
help.navidrome: Use your Navidrome login (a separate user with few rights is a good idea).
help.github: A fine-grained token with read-only access to “Contents” and “Metadata” of the repositories you want is enough.
help.gitlab: A personal access token with the read_api scope.
help.gitea: Without a token only public repositories work. Settings → Applications → a token with read access to repositories.
help.pihole: Pi-hole 6: the web password or an app password. Pi-hole 5: the API token (Settings → API).
help.homeassistant: Your profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens.
help.uptimekuma: The part after /status/ in the status page's address.
help.glances: Run Glances in web server mode (glances -w); a login only if you set one.
help.custom: Widgets then ask for paths under this address (e.g. v1/stats).

errors.urlInvalid: Please enter a valid http(s) URL.
errors.placeholderMissing: The URL must contain %s for the search query.
errors.keywordTaken: That keyword is already used by another provider.
errors.tooMany: That's the most there can be.

board.editHelp: Drag to move, drag an edge to resize. Arrow keys move a focused widget, Shift + arrows resize it.
board.keys: {{w}} by {{h}} cells. Arrow keys move it, Shift + arrow keys resize it, Enter opens its settings, Delete removes it.
board.empty: Nothing on this page. Press Edit to add widgets.
board.phoneLayout: You're arranging the phone layout; the desktop layout stays as it is.

widgets.stale: Showing the last answer; couldn't refresh.
widgets.crashed: This widget ran into a problem. Change its settings or remove it.

integration.pick: Pick an integration in this widget's settings ({{kinds}}). Add one under Customize → Integrations.
integration.missing: Its integration was removed. Pick another one in the widget's settings.
integration.broken: Its integration needs its password or key again (Customize → Integrations).
integration.unavailable: Your integrations couldn't be loaded right now.

clock.name: Clock
clock.text: The time, digital or analog, with seconds and any time zone.

worldclock.name: World clocks
worldclock.text: Several time zones at a glance, with day or night.
worldclock.empty: Edit the widget and add time zones.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.text: This month at a glance, with week numbers if you like.

countdown.name: Countdown
countdown.text: Days, hours and minutes until (or since) a date; yearly if you like.
countdown.empty: Edit the widget and pick a date.

weather.name: Weather
weather.text: Now, the next hours and days, from open-meteo.com.
weather.empty: Edit the widget and pick a place.

note.name: Note
note.text: A sticky note, saved (and synced) as you type.

todo.name: To-do
todo.text: A checklist, synced with your account.

search.name: Search box
search.text: An extra search box for one engine.

bookmarks.text: Your links as a grid, app tiles, a list or icons, with live up / down dots if you like.

releases.name: Releases
releases.text: New versions from GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg / Gitea, npm, PyPI, Docker Hub and crates.io.
releases.empty: Edit the widget and add repositories or packages.

repo.name: Repository
repo.text: Stars, forks, issues, the latest commits and open pull requests of one repository.

library.name: Library
